distill.rationale: Exact narrow apply of a frozen planning candidate with unchanged ten-unit decomposition.

techniques.application: Precheck, material gate, exact create, live validation, and closeout execute in order.
All 84 creates bind exact staged and live SHA-256 values.
The applied plan is exercised through unit, WPRA, readiness, and controller consumers.
Positive, negative, lifecycle, readiness, and controller gates preserve every exit.
Rondelli apply authority does not become owner acceptance or execution authority.
Apply closes with authority none and routes separately to v2 preacceptance closure.
The failed readiness attempt and remaining closure, review, acceptance, selection, and execution gates stay visible.
Evidence remains run-local without telemetry mutation.
Writes are limited to the run root and exact canonical inventory.
